product_metadata.title: aya Sushi Making Kit - Original Eco Sushi Kit - All Natural Eco-friendly - Biodegradable Bamboo - 2 Sushi Mats - 5 Pairs of Chopsticks - 1 Paddle - 1 Spreader
features: The AYA ECO SUSHI KIT MAX is 100% eco-friendly. All natural and biodegradable sushi roller set for beginners, experts and professionals.

All packaging is 100% biodegradable. Make the best sushi rolls with your loved ones in the comfort of your home. Enjoy creating tuna and salmon nigiris, California rolls and rainbow rolls with family and friends.

This product is made of 100% recyclable and biodegradable material. Best eco-friendly gift idea for Christmas, Mother's Day, Father's Day, birthdays, and Hanukkah. Surprise your loved ones with this unique sushi making kit while having the lowest impact on the environment.
The AYA ECO SUSHI KIT MAX includes 2 natural premium bamboo mats, rice spreader, spatula and 5 chopsticks. Roll delicious sushi rolls with this AYA bamboo sushi maker set.
